description: This Kotlin source file defines a Dagger Hilt module 'DataModule' that provides dependency bindings for various repository and utility interfaces within the 'core.data' layer of the project. It uses abstract functions annotated with @Binds to bind interface types to their concrete implementations, facilitating dependency injection throughout the app.

classes.name: DataModule
classes.description: An abstract class annotated with @Module and @InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class), which provides dependency bindings for repository and utility interfaces using @Binds methods.
